AnnuityTiming.description: When the payments of an annuity or perpetuity occur.

oneOf.description: Payments at the end of each period (first payment at t = 1).
Payments at the beginning of each period (first payment at t = 0).

growth.description:
Growth of the payment per period, decimal fraction, greater than -1. Default: 0 (level
perpetuity).

rate.description: Discount rate per period, decimal fraction; must exceed `growth`.

timing.description: `ordinary` (first payment at t = 1) or `due` (first payment at t = 0).
